caption: The drawing features a single, intricately detailed silver pitcher with a wide, rounded body, a narrow neck, and a flared rim. The pitcher has a decorative, curved handle attached to its left side. Its body displays vertically faceted panels that contribute to its geometric and symmetrical appearance. The pitcher stands on a short, wide pedestal foot with a polygonal base. Below and slightly to the left side of the pitcher, there is a secondary illustration showing a close-up view of the pitcher’s side, focusing on an engraved inscription. The inscription reads: "Presented to D J K by J B: Aug 3, 1843." The drawing consists of grayscale pencil shading on a light beige background. Near the bottom right corner of the page, the word “Granel” is written in small, simple script.
title: Silver Mug
